{"notes": "Visit 2 (left 2:45). I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting anyone with specific placements. The picture shows the chain closed and dark all the way round the tail, with no visible break. The earlier stray near (23.6, 8.1) is gone. One pale domino remains at about (20.3, 7.8) on the top line by the dip. The belly line near x 24-26 looks crowded or doubled and is worth a check.

SOFIA: First direct evidence, and it's good. She gave a clear plan (sweep down the right side, stop at the tail tip, no second line over the belly). She told Jack to hold off to avoid doubling up, and she committed to inspecting the join. At 2:30 she agreed that the pale strays were fine to remove and said she was finishing the tail. The closed tail fits what she said. Strong collaboration and coordination. Still to verify: that she did inspect the join, and whether the crowded spot near x 24-26 is a double line.

OMAR: Now has evidence. He said the belly is done and carries from the start, and the picture matches. He's clearing pale strays under the top line, which is sensible. He handed the tail join to Sofia and Jack clearly. Good communication and ownership. One pale domino is still near the dip, so I need to see whether he finishes that.

HANA: I didn't see or hear her this visit. Her design appears to be reflected in the finished tail, but I can't say who built it. The pad question is still unresolved. Execution is still unproven.

JACK: Not observed. Sofia told him to hold off, so waiting was appropriate. Still no evidence he acted on his offer to patch.

NEXT: Watch the fall test, the stray at the dip, and the join inspection. Ask Hana and Jack privately what they built."}
